mintAuthority.summary: YieldFi yUSD has ten reviewed native issuance deployments: the Ethereum YToken and nine chain-local YTokenL2 vaults. Users can mint local vault shares against each chain's configured asset, while the common Manager exposes a discretionary mintYToken/manageAssetAndShares path with no protocol supply ceiling. The native YIELD role path remains in Mint Authority; BridgeCCIP BRIDGE/LOCKBOX burn-mint accounting, peer configuration, LockBox escrow, and Chainlink CCIP validation are scored separately under Bridge Risk. Two bytecode-less ADMIN EOAs can change the native operator set immediately, so the canonical posture remains unbounded-or-compromised; base-asset USDC/USDT issuance remains an upstream dependency.

controls.label: YieldFi YToken/YTokenL2 local share issuance
controls.capDescription: The Ethereum YToken and nine YTokenL2 deployments mint local vault shares through ERC-4626 deposit/mint against each chain's configured asset; this share issuance does not mint the upstream base asset.
controls.evidence: At current reads on 2026-08-16 UTC, all ten authored token deployments had nonzero supply, a chain-local asset(), and manager() = 0x03acc35286baae6d73d99a9f14ef13752208c8dc plus administrator() = 0x10472f91f67c49260bdd65f016ea0757bb1fc91e. Ethereum uses verified YToken implementation 0x5bf44d32260aee6b807c490e92ef0481d15ab493; Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Sonic, and Plume use verified YTokenL2 implementation 0x5d83b88f8770de1788e89cc1ec5b2cda8287212c; Katana, BNB, Avalanche, and Plasma use verified implementation 0x52cb1a9a9154f0e0a3c7ce08f95caee6062dbca9. Each local ERC-4626 deposit/mint path creates local vault shares and does not provide an independent base-asset mint path.

controls.label: YieldFi Manager discretionary share mint/burn (all native deployments)
controls.capDescription: The common Manager's manageAssetAndShares and manager-only mintYToken/burnYToken paths can adjust arbitrary yUSD shares with no protocol supply ceiling on each local deployment. Native share issuance through the YIELD role remains Mint Authority; BRIDGE and LOCKBOX route accounting is separately authored under Bridge Risk.
controls.evidence: Verified Manager implementations on the authored chains expose local ERC-4626 share issuance plus manager-only mintYToken/burnYToken and manageAssetAndShares. At Ethereum block 25575158, the YIELD role had five contract holders (0x392017161a9507f19644e8886a237c58809212b5, 0xe017bc7793b649ffcfe30d55fa1474f03e1714f7, 0x2e3c5e514eef46727de1fe44618027a9b70d92fc, 0x3073112c2c4800b89764973d5790ccc7fba5c9f9, 0x1e2a5622178f93efd4349e2eb3dbdf2761749e1b), and the verified source applies no supply ceiling to the discretionary path. The BRIDGE holders, LOCKBOX holder, BridgeCCIP burn/mint calls, and Ethereum LockBox are retained as structured Bridge Risk controls rather than compiled as native issuance.

controls.label: YieldFi Administrator native-issuance role registry (all native deployments)
controls.capDescription: The common Administrator is the role registry consulted by each local Manager. Granting YIELD here immediately confers the uncapped native discretionary share-mint path; BRIDGE and LOCKBOX role administration is scored separately under Bridge Risk.
controls.evidence: Verified Administrator implementation 0xccaa27e3db44e06bd9001958de5b41301fd28002 stores roles in a plain mapping and exposes hasRole(bytes32,address). Its grantRoles and revokeRoles functions carry modifier onlyAdmin and take effect in the same transaction; the native YIELD role therefore remains an immediate authorization surface for each local Manager. ADMIN-role grants alone are deferred through scheduleAdminRole/executeAdminRole with timeLockPeriod() = 14400 seconds read at block 25575158. The Administrator's separate BRIDGE and LOCKBOX role registry is represented in Bridge Risk.

controls.label: YieldFi Administrator ADMIN-role EOAs (common native dependency)
controls.capDescription: Either ADMIN key can grant itself or any address a YIELD role in one transaction and then mint uncapped local yUSD shares through the Manager. No timelock, quorum, or guard stands between an ADMIN key and unlimited native share issuance; bridge-role administration is separately scored under Bridge Risk.
bypassSurfaces: A single ADMIN key can self-appoint as an operator and mint unbounded yUSD shares in the same block.
controls.evidence: The complete Administrator RoleGranted/RoleRevoked replay from block 22364994, confirmed by live hasRole reads at block 25575158, returns exactly two current ADMIN holders: 0xa6e98a21ea3cbe891b8a24f7233443748c17b387 and 0x241ac00dc77fc1981e0483de3da3828b787b8764. eth_getCode returns empty bytecode for both, so neither is a Safe, multisig, or timelock. Verified source shows grantRoles and revokeRoles are onlyAdmin and immediate. Re-verified 2026-07-28 block 25629035: both ADMIN EOAs still hold keccak256("ADMIN") on dual independent RPCs; both remain bytecode-less.

controls.label: YieldFi TimelockController proposer/executor EOA (common native upgrade path)
controls.capDescription: A single EOA holds PROPOSER, CANCELLER, and EXECUTOR on the YieldFiTimelockController. The reviewed Ethereum path owns the YToken, Manager, and Administrator ProxyAdmins, while the nine local YTokenL2 proxies and their verified implementations are included in the native multi-deployment upgrade coverage; the common-mode caveat remains that the complete per-chain proxy-admin mapping was not independently enumerated in this migration.
bypassSurfaces: The same EOA is one of the two Administrator ADMIN keys, so it can mint uncapped yUSD shares instantly through the role path without waiting for the timelock.
controls.evidence: Verified on-chain 2026-07-30 at Ethereum block 25648573 on ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com, corroborated by eth.drpc.org: the EIP-1967 admin slots of the three YieldFi proxies resolve to three distinct OZ ProxyAdmins — vault 0x19ebd191f7a24ece672ba13a302212b5ef7f35cb to 0xe26e1d2ae51dcb89e382ca7400b080e6632117b9, Manager 0x03acc35286baae6d73d99a9f14ef13752208c8dc to 0x25249946d42a5fba2b6b1d191127bcaec70bd103, Administrator 0x10472f91f67c49260bdd65f016ea0757bb1fc91e to 0xc79920d40206cc28f7b70e72d623ff7fb83004c1 — and owner() on each ProxyAdmin returns YieldFiTimelockController 0x8e31efda4453494a84fa6168d53eb1418c0b4ac4 with getMinDelay() = 86400. A complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked event replay of the timelock from its deployment block 22484772 (Blockscout) shows DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE granted only to the timelock itself and PROPOSER_ROLE, CANCELLER_ROLE, and EXECUTOR_ROLE granted to 0xa6e98a21ea3cbe891b8a24f7233443748c17b387 with zero revocation events; live hasRole reads at block 25648573 confirm all three roles remain held, and eth_getCode returns empty bytecode for the EOA. This corrects the 2026-07-20 claim that the timelock had zero role holders and that the upgrade path was inert.

review.evidence: Reviewed 2026-08-16: all ten authored deployments are local native YToken/YTokenL2 ERC-4626 issuance paths with chain-local assets, common Manager 0x03acc35286baae6d73d99a9f14ef13752208c8dc, and common Administrator 0x10472f91f67c49260bdd65f016ea0757bb1fc91e. The native YIELD role path and immediate ADMIN ability to change its operators remain in Mint Authority; the Manager's BRIDGE/LOCKBOX path, BridgeCCIP contracts, peers, Ethereum LockBox, and Chainlink CCIP validation are represented separately in Bridge Risk. The reviewed Manager source provides no protocol supply ceiling, so authorityPosture remains unbounded-or-compromised and economicCapSemantics remains unbounded. The nine YTokenL2 implementations are included in upgradeability coverage alongside the three Ethereum proxy implementations; the common 86400-second Ethereum Timelock path and its ADMIN-EOA bypass remain adverse. YieldFi publishes no dated whole-supply reconciliation or independent prudential supervision, so reconciliation remains unknown and supervision remains none.
